sources.fact: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data was last updated 26 June 2026 and the current published monthly release is May 2026; data is updated monthly.
PPD covers property sales in England and Wales sold for value and lodged with HM Land Registry; unlodged or non-value transactions are outside the dataset.
Published columns include transaction identifier, price, transfer date, postcode, property type, new/old indicator, tenure code and address fields.
Duration indicates freehold or leasehold, but leases of 7 years or less are not recorded in PPD; this field is not an exact title-register substitute.
Category A and B identify classes of transaction; Category B aggregates several transaction circumstances and does not separately identify each circumstance.
Excluded cases include sales not lodged, non-value transfers, gifts, some discounted sales, CPO/court transfers and specified multi-property transmissions/assents.
HMLR warns public PPD cannot be guaranteed error-free or fit for every purpose and may not reflect the most recent information.
PPD address data includes postcode, PAON, SAON, street, locality, town/city, district and county; address data has separate third-party usage conditions.
The latest published UK HPI report is May 2026, published 22 July 2026; it is aggregate market evidence based on completed transactions.
May 2026 UK HPI downloads provide aggregate average-price, sales, property-type, new-build and other attributes and revision tables.
HMLR administrative-data documentation confirms PPD address fields and transaction identifiers; property characteristics describe registrations rather than legal geometry.

The National Data Library describes PPD as transaction evidence including sale price/date, property type, tenure and new-build status, suitable for market research rather than current ownership proof.

examples.result: A matching PPD address and sale does not prove current ownership; an exact current HMLR title/register is still required.
PPD freehold/leasehold code is not converted into an exact title number or legal parcel polygon.
A missing PPD row is not evidence that no transfer occurred because excluded/unlodged/non-value transactions exist.
Historic postcode/PAON/SAON matching is treated as address evidence only and is not silently joined to a candidate polygon without corroboration.
Category B is not expanded into a guessed transaction subtype.
UK HPI regional or London averages are not used as parcel-specific market value.
Recent PPD incompleteness/registration timing is retained as a recency caveat rather than scored as inactivity.
No candidate promotion occurs from transaction history without exact title/parcel and current planning/statutory binding.
